entries.surface: development canonical JSON and SHA-256 primitives
entries.reason: Existing utility is deterministic for its declared subset but has no explicit profile/projection/legacy registry semantics.
ArtifactProfile is packet-input and authority configuration, not SerializationProfile.
Consumer implementation remains controlling until a later shadow adapter; no reverse dependency is introduced.
Its numeric and negative-zero rules cannot be selected from the hash-algorithm label and are not silently merged.
Identity-critical golden vectors require a separately coded comparator rather than self-comparison.
